protocol: Three consecutive completed training jobs; pair each changing checkpoint with the same incumbent on unseen maps/seeds and swapped seats. Distances are means across evaluations. Low displacement is pooled over unseen windows. Close-contact counts use the actual equipment fixtures and matched starts. Cohort results cannot isolate a training intervention.
intervention: Skip the 0.01 new-cell reward when a whole unseen search window backs at least 4 m net, its center ray is clear for at least 4 m, its flanking rays see no smoke, and its sighting memory has expired. Leave escape, discovery and combat rewards intact.
rewardAudit: Run self-play-rollout.ts with seed 1754309821, 48 episodes, 45 seconds, --focus waiting --focus wall and the bundled opponent. Score each stored trace under the original and revised reward, with initial rewards zeroed. The engineered positive control subtracts 1 from the bundled actor's raw forward bias only. It tests the scorer; it is not a trained candidate. Opponent league sampling may differ between actors. Compare the scorers within each actor's identical trajectories.
